categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sale of plastic injection moulding machines and related products. It also provides parts and services associated with these machines. The business is focused on producing diversified machine models catering to various downstream industries such as daily consumer products, home appliances, 3C products, and the automobile industry, including new energy vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced plastic injection moulding technology with continuous innovation in electric pre-plasticising technology and integrated polyurethane reaction and injection molding processes. It emphasizes energy-efficient and intelligent solutions, including the fifth generation (G5) models equipped with digital management software 'Go Factory 2.0' and open integration functions. The company also invests in intelligent technologies, big data, Internet of Things, and energy-saving green technologies to optimize performance, reduce costs, and improve efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are manufacturers in downstream industries such as daily consumer products, home appliances, 3C electronics, and the automotive sector, particularly new energy vehicles. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international customers in Southeast Asia, North America, South America, and other overseas regions. It targets niche markets with customized solutions and value-added services to deepen market penetration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in Mainland China, which accounts for approximately 62.7% of sales, with significant overseas sales (37.3%) in Southeast Asia, North America, South America, Hong Kong, and other international markets. It has production facilities and subsidiaries in China, Vietnam, Mexico, Japan, and other locations, with ongoing global investments including new factories in Japan and Serbia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of plastic injection moulding machines and related components. It also engages in downstream activities by providing customized solutions and after-sales services to its customers. The company sources raw materials and components but focuses on manufacturing and assembly of machinery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include technology innovation, green transformation, and digitalization. The company focuses on developing new generation machine models, optimizing existing products for performance and cost, and investing in intelligent technologies such as big data and IoT. It emphasizes energy-saving and sustainable solutions, aiming to reduce energy consumption and enhance product lifecycle value. The company also pursues global expansion and supply chain localization to mitigate geopolitical risks.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of plastic injection moulding machines and related products, recognized at a point in time upon delivery. Additional revenue comes from sales of parts and after-sales services. The company also engages in connected transactions involving purchase of smart solution products and CNC machinery from related entities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading pioneer and industry benchmark setter in the plastic injection moulding machine sector. It leverages its first-mover advantage in overseas investments and global deployment to strengthen market share. The company emphasizes quality, service, and technological leadership to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of approximately RMB16.13 billion in 2024, representing a 23.4% increase from 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB3.08 billion, up 23.6% year-on-year, with a stable net profit margin of 19.1%. The company maintains a strong financial position with net cash of approximately RMB4.12 billion and total equity of RMB20.85 billion. It has shown consistent growth over recent years with expanding capital expenditures and global investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced, energy-efficient, and intelligent plastic injection moulding machines that reduce operating energy consumption by 20-40%. It offers customized solutions and value-added services to enhance customer satisfaction and stickiness. Its focus on technology innovation, green transformation, and digital integration provides customers with efficient, sustainable production solutions, supporting their competitiveness and operational efficiency.
